pin.label: A match id or link
pin.hint: A pinned match joins the end of the list and keeps its place until unpinned.

list.title: Pinned
list.empty: Nothing pinned. The home TV's Staff picks channel shows while at least one match is pinned.
list.foot: The home TV's Staff picks channel plays these in this order.

said.unknown_match: There is no match with that id. Paste its address from the watch page.
said.match_not_public: That match is not public yet: a pick names a finished match that is not part of a trial in progress. Pin it once it has finished.
said.order_incomplete: Another admin changed the picks meanwhile. The list now shows them as they stand; move it again.
said.unknown_pick: That pick was already unpinned. The list now shows them as they stand.
said.admin_only: This account is no longer an admin.

refusals.empty: Paste a match's id or its /matches/ address.
refusals.unreachable: The API did not answer; nothing changed.
